screen: County-held-out M3 facility address-mismatch linear term plus missingness indicator; unregistered

method.outcome: Pinned frozen S1 orthogonalized-disagreement residual; no target or model labels.
method.design: intercept + one train-standardized linear M3 share + one binary M3-missingness indicator; OLS via np.linalg.lstsq. Train mean/SD are computed on defined M3 training rows only. Undefined values are imputed to share zero before standardizing and explicitly marked by missingness=1; observed zero remains missingness=0.
method.validation: Within each official region, hold one county FIPS out and fit using all other counties only. Every official tract with frozen S1 residual is evaluated once, including M3-undefined rows.
method.baseline: Uncorrected frozen S1 residual, prediction correction fixed at zero, on the identical complete S1 residual support.
method.metric: Pooled and region-specific held-out delta-R2=(baseline SSE-model SSE)/baseline SSE, baseline SSE=sum(frozen residual^2).
method.uncertainty: Paired county-block percentile bootstrap; resample held-out counties with replacement within each region, fixed seed and 2,000 replicates.
method.missingness: Not dropped; report feature coverage by region/county and include an indicator so missing rows are distinct from observed zero shares.
method.interpretation_limit: Provided-feature residual association only; not target accuracy, causal evidence or authorization to promote/integrate.

county_block_bootstrap.resampling: paired county OOF results; counties sampled with replacement within each official region

config.feature_transform: observed-train mean/SD; missing M3 imputed zero before transform; missing indicator is separate binary term
config.model: intercept + standardized linear M3 share + M3 missingness indicator; no tuning
config.fold: leave one county FIPS out within each official region

interpretation: The M3 linear-plus-missingness screen failed one or more gates; retain the uncorrected frozen S1 residual and do not integrate.
